caption: The drawing features two primary objects positioned horizontally on a plain, light background. At the top of the image, there is a straight, red rod with a hooked end, with the red color being uniform throughout its length. Below this rod, centrally placed, is a side view of a saw handle and a partial saw blade. The handle is colored in shades of beige and light brown, giving it a wooden appearance with subtle shading to suggest a three-dimensional form. The visible portion of the saw blade is rectangular and rendered with a pattern of small, alternating colored pieces in light blue, pale yellow, white, brown, and gray, with gold diagonal bands running along it. There is a bolt or rivet shown near where the blade meets the handle. Below the objects, the text “A 3580 - 284 LYMAN YOUNG” is neatly written. The entire composition is centered with ample blank space surrounding the objects and text.
title: Walking Stick
